lessons.title: PROTECT THE GIFT
lessons.body: An overnight indicated double on a 1-lot is a gift. From this stamp forward, +50% on a 1-lot must REALIZE PROFIT or become a PROTECTED RUNNER with a published premium floor. +100% is a harvest or a tightened floor — not an unprotected hold into the cash open. This lesson is forward-only. It does not rewrite Trade Zero.

methodology.peakOpportunityPct: (highest verified executable bid after referenceEntry − referenceEntry) ÷ referenceEntry × 100
methodology.referenceEntry: First verifiable executable ASK after the timestamped public alert, inside preferred entry range, at or below maximum entry, before alert expiration/invalidation, with enough displayed size for the model position.
methodology.opportunityIdentifiedYes: Contract reaches at least +25% from verified referenceEntry on a verifiable executable BID after the public alert.
rejectedPeakSources: overnight theoretical mark while options market closed
methodology.captureRate: managed realized profit ÷ maximum verified opportunity profit — only when Peak Opportunity is positive AND managed profit is positive AND both use verified executable data.
methodology.managedBalance: startingCash + unique-id managed P&L (including approved pre-rule baseline). Peak and all-or-nothing dollars never enter.
